title: NY State Senate · District 19
area: Southeast Brooklyn (Canarsie, East New York, Brownsville) and parts of Lindenwood and Howard Beach, Queens

context.text: Roxanne Persaud is unopposed on the November 3 general-election ballot. Her Democratic primary, scheduled for June 23, 2026, was canceled because she had no primary opponent.

candidates.name: Roxanne Persaud
candidates.ballotNote: Nominated without a primary opponent; running unopposed in the general election

summary.text: Roxanne Persaud is the incumbent Democratic state senator for District 19, first elected in 2015 after one term in the State Assembly. She chairs the Senate Social Services Committee and is running unopposed for a sixth Senate term.

background.text: Born in Guyana and immigrated to the U.S. with her family.
Holds a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Science in Education Administration from Pace University; worked in higher-education administration before elected office.
Served as President of the 69th Precinct Community Council, a member of Community Board 18, and a Commissioner on the NYC Districting Commission before joining the legislature.

Elected to the State Assembly's 59th District in the November 2014 general election, taking office in 2015; won a special election for the State Senate later that year, succeeding John L. Sampson, who had been removed from office.
Chairs the Senate Social Services Committee in the 2025-2026 session; also sits on the Cities 1, Codes, Disabilities, Children and Families, New York City Education, and Transportation committees.

priorities.text: Safer communities, including legislation to tackle gun violence
Supportive services for youth and seniors
Aiding small businesses and building "a vigorous social service agenda"

positions.summary: Sponsored S9491, which would let state agencies, municipalities, and public authorities extend public benefits to residents regardless of federal immigration-status restrictions.
Sponsored S9084, establishing a maternal-health remote-monitoring pilot program for Medicaid recipients managing pregnancy-related hypertension and diabetes.

record.text: Sponsored S9491, providing eligibility for state or local public benefits regardless of immigration status; referred to the Senate Finance Committee as of March 2026.

Sponsored S9084, establishing a two-year maternal health monitoring pilot program with $600,000 in state funding for up to 500 Medicaid recipients; passed the Senate Women's Issues Committee in May 2026 and was referred to Finance.

Secured state budget items for District 19 and statewide social-service programs in the SFY 2026-2027 budget, including added funding for the Nutrition Outreach and Education Program, the Disability Assistance Program, statewide diaper banks, and a $200,000 NYPD Youth Explorer program allocation for the district.
Chairs the Senate Social Services Committee in the 2025-2026 session.

sources.title: Senator Roxanne J. Persaud Secures Victories in SFY 2026-2027 New York State Budget

researchNotes: Roxanne Persaud has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey. Her campaign site's general priority statements did not map to specific stances on most of the guide's fixed issue list beyond immigration and healthcare, which are documented above through sponsored bills.
